verdict.rationale: Pipecat is an open-source (BSD-2) Python framework. A runtime probe confirmed it pip-installs and imports with no key. The docs state bot files are portable to "most production self-hosting setups", and agents can run distributed across your own processes and machines. missing for 10: a detailed first-party production self-hosting deployment guide (the built-in dev runner is explicitly not supported for production), and independent hands-on reports of production self-hosted deployments.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure

citations.quote: pypi pipecat-ai 1.8.1 (BSD-2 OSS) installs and `import pipecat` succeeds with no key, printing its startup banner — the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable.
